title: A Weekend at the Grand Hotel

sentences.text_target: Tom and Sarah arrive at the grand hotel for the weekend.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm ænd ˈsærə əˈraɪv æt ðə ɡrænd həʊˈtɛl fɔː ðə ˈwiːkˌɛnd.
sentences.text_native: Tom et Sarah arrivent au grand hôtel pour le week-end.

sentences.text_target: A yellow taxi stops in front of the building.
sentences.phonetic: ə ˈjɛləʊ ˈtæksi stɒps ɪn frʌnt ɒv ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ.
sentences.text_native: Un taxi jaune s'arrête devant le bâtiment.

sentences.text_target: They step out onto the busy street with their baggage.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ stɛp aʊt ˈɒntuː ðə ˈbɪzi striːt wɪð ðeər ˈbæɡɪdʒ.
sentences.text_native: Ils descendent dans la rue animée avec leurs bagages.

sentences.text_target: The heavy suitcases are hard to pull.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈhɛvi ˈsuːtˌkeɪsɪz ɑː hɑːd tuː pʊl.
sentences.text_native: Ces valises lourdes sont difficiles à tirer.

sentences.text_target: They walk through the automatic glass doors inside.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ wɔːk θruː ði ˌɔːtəˈmætɪk ɡlɑːs dɔːz ˈɪnˈsaɪd.
sentences.text_native: Ils franchissent les portes vitrées automatiques pour entrer.

sentences.text_target: The reception area is bright and very quiet.
sentences.phonetic: ðə rɪˈsɛpʃən ˈeərɪə ɪz braɪt ænd ˈvɛri ˈkwaɪət.
sentences.text_native: L'espace d'accueil est lumineux et très calme.

sentences.text_target: There is a small queue at the counter.
sentences.phonetic: ðeər ɪz ə smɔːl kjuː æt ðə ˈkaʊntə.
sentences.text_native: Il y a une petite file d'attente au comptoir.

sentences.text_target: They wait for their turn patiently.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ weɪt fɔː ðeər tɜːn ˈpeɪʃəntli.
sentences.text_native: Ils attendent leur tour patiemment.

sentences.text_target: A friendly receptionist smiles at them.
sentences.phonetic: ə ˈfrɛndli rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst smaɪlz æt ðɛm.
sentences.text_native: Un réceptionniste sympathique leur sourit.

sentences.text_target: Good evening, sir and madam, says the young man.
sentences.phonetic: ɡʊd ˈiːvnɪŋ, sɜː ænd ˈmædəm, sɛz ðə jʌŋ mæn.
sentences.text_native: « Bonsoir, monsieur et madame », dit le jeune homme.

sentences.text_target: Tom speaks in English and explains the reservation.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm spiːks ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ænd ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə ˌrɛzəˈveɪʃən.
sentences.text_native: Tom parle en anglais et explique la réservation.

sentences.text_target: He booked a double room online last week.
sentences.phonetic: hiː bʊkt ə ˈdʌbl ruːm ˈɒnˌlaɪn lɑːst wiːk.
sentences.text_native: Il a réservé une chambre double en ligne la semaine dernière.

sentences.text_target: The receptionist checks the computer screen carefully.
sentences.phonetic: ðə rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst tʃɛks ðə kəmˈpjuːtə skriːn ˈkeəfʊli.
sentences.text_native: Le réceptionniste examine attentivement l'écran de l'ordinateur.

sentences.text_target: He looks at all the details on the monitor.
sentences.phonetic: hiː lʊks æt ɔːl ðə ˈdiːteɪlz ɒn ðə ˈmɒnɪtə.
sentences.text_native: Il regarde tous les détails affichés.

sentences.text_target: Tom gives his passport to prove his identity.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm ɡɪvz ɪz ˈpɑːspɔːt tuː pruːv ɪz aɪˈdɛntɪti.
sentences.text_native: Tom donne son passeport pour prouver son identité.

sentences.text_target: Sarah fills out a registration form with a black pen.
sentences.phonetic: ˈsærə fɪlz aʊt ə ˌrɛdʒɪˈstreɪʃən fɔːm wɪð ə blæk pɛn.
sentences.text_native: Sarah remplit une fiche d'inscription avec un stylo noir.

sentences.text_target: Please sign your name and surname here, says the worker.
sentences.phonetic: pliːz saɪn jɔː neɪm ænd ˈsɜːneɪm hɪə, sɛz ðə ˈwɜːkə.
sentences.text_native: « Veuillez signer ici », dit l'employé.

sentences.text_target: She writes her signature quickly on the paper.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː raɪts hɜː ˈsɪɡnətʃə ˈkwɪkli ɒn ðə ˈpeɪpə.
sentences.text_native: Elle appose rapidement sa signature sur le papier.

sentences.text_target: Now, it is time to pay for the night.
sentences.phonetic: naʊ, ɪt ɪz taɪm tuː peɪ fɔː ðə naɪt.
sentences.text_native: Il est maintenant temps de régler la nuitée.

sentences.text_target: Tom takes his credit card out of his wallet.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm teɪks ɪz ˈkrɛdɪt kɑːd aʊt ɒv ɪz ˈwɒlɪt.
sentences.text_native: Tom sort sa carte de crédit de son portefeuille.

sentences.text_target: He inserts the card into the payment machine.
sentences.phonetic: hiː ɪnˈsɜːts ðə kɑːd ˈɪntuː ðə ˈpeɪmənt məˈʃiːn.
sentences.text_native: Il insère la carte dans le terminal de paiement.

sentences.text_target: He types his secret pin code with a small button.
sentences.phonetic: hiː taɪps ɪz ˈsiːkrɪt pɪn kəʊd wɪð ə smɔːl ˈbʌtn.
sentences.text_native: Il tape son code secret sur le petit clavier.

sentences.text_target: The printer makes a noise and prints a receipt.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈprɪntə meɪks ə nɔɪz ænd prɪnts ə rɪˈsiːt.
sentences.text_native: L'imprimante émet un bruit et sort un reçu.

sentences.text_target: Welcome to our hotel, says the receptionist with a smile.
sentences.phonetic: ˈwɛlkəm tuː ˈaʊə həʊˈtɛl, sɛz ðə rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst wɪð ə smaɪl.
sentences.text_native: « Bienvenue dans notre hôtel », dit le réceptionniste avec un sourire.

sentences.text_target: He hands them a plastic card in a paper packet.
sentences.phonetic: hiː hændz ðɛm ə ˈplæstɪk kɑːd ɪn ə ˈpeɪpə ˈpækɪt.
sentences.text_native: Il leur remet une carte magnétique glissée dans une pochette en papier.

sentences.text_target: Your room number is twelve on the second floor.
sentences.phonetic: jɔː ruːm ˈʌmbə ɪz twɛlv ɒn ðə ˈsɛkənd flɔː.
sentences.text_native: Votre chambre est la numéro douze, au deuxième étage.

sentences.text_target: They take the lift up and find the correct hallway.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ teɪk ðə lɪft ʌp ænd faɪnd ðə kəˈrɛkt ˈhɔːlweɪ.
sentences.text_native: Ils prennent l'ascenseur et trouvent le bon couloir.

sentences.text_target: Tom opens the wooden door with the smart card.
sentences.phonetic: tɒm ˈəʊpənz ðə ˈwʊdn dɔː wɪð ðə smɑːt kɑːd.
sentences.text_native: Tom ouvre la porte en bois grâce à la carte à puce.

sentences.text_target: The big bed looks very comfortable after a long journey.
sentences.phonetic: ðə bɪɡ bɛd lʊks ˈvɛri ˈkʌmfətəbl ˈɑːftər ə lɒŋ ˈdʒɜːni.
sentences.text_native: Le grand lit a l'air très confortable après ce long voyage.

sentences.text_target: They are very tired and ready to sleep all night.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ ɑː ˈvɛri ˈtaɪəd ænd ˈrɛdi tuː sliːp ɔːl naɪt.
sentences.text_native: Ils sont très fatigués et prêts à dormir toute la nuit.
